about.no_notice: The operator has not provided a privacy notice.
about.text:
**What happens to texts:** they are sent to the language model configured by the operator and kept only in the memory of your session. Uploaded files are deleted right after reading; exported files are deleted after a short time. Nothing is stored in your browser.

**Limits:** results are produced by a language model and can contain errors or additions. The warnings under the result are heuristic checks, not guarantees.
app.intro:
## Text Style Transfer
Derive a writing style from your own texts, adjust it and export it as a skill in the tab **🪄 My style → skill**. The other tabs rewrite texts with these settings or with packaged styles. Texts are processed by the language model configured by the operator.
common.text_language_info: Language of the text you enter. The result stays in this language; choosing a profile does not change it.
copy.description_ph: e.g. short sentences, warm and personal, a touch of irony
copy.done: Profile created and selected as own profile.
copy.intro: Derive a profile **from reference texts** (left) or **from a description** (right). The result becomes your own profile and sets the sliders.
copy.next_steps: **Next:** try the profile on a text in “Transform”, adjust sliders and targets in the side bar “⚙️ Settings”, then export it under “Profile”. The tab “My style → skill” guides through these steps.
copy.references_info: Separate several texts with a line containing only ---. From about 80 words and five sentences on, sentence values are measured as well.
custom.intro: Own sliders become part of your own profile and travel with its code. The instruction goes to the model as written.
custom.label: Name
custom.limit: At most {limit} own sliders per profile.
custom.missing_opposite: A slider with two poles needs a name and an instruction for the opposite pole.
custom.not_found: There is no own slider with this number.
custom.title: Own sliders
custom.value_info: For intensity, only 1 to 10 is valid.
custom.value_invalid: The value does not fit the type.
export.nothing: There is no result to export yet.
history.intro: Runs of this session. The history exists only in this browser tab and is gone when you close it.
history.missing: There is no entry with this number.
issue.analysis_contradicts_count: The analysis set “{slider}”, but the count in the reference texts contradicts it. Please check this slider.
issue.analysis_invalid_json: The model did not return a usable profile. Please try again.
issue.check_above_target: The result is much longer than intended ({words} instead of about {target} words). Most common cause: the model added evaluations or closing sentences of its own. Please check the end of the text.
issue.check_below_target: The result is much shorter than intended ({words} instead of about {target} words). Content may have been lost.
issue.check_empty_output: The model returned an empty text.
issue.check_formal_familiar: Formal style is set, but the result contains familiar forms of address or contractions.
issue.check_informal_formal: Informal style is set, but the result addresses the reader only formally.
issue.check_language_drift: The result seems to be written in {found} instead of {expected}.
issue.check_numbers_missing: Numbers from the input are missing in the result: {numbers}. Please check the facts.
issue.check_quotes_lost: Of {before} quotations only {after} are still marked as quotations. Statements attributed to a person may now read as claims of the text itself.
issue.check_slider_direction: “{slider}”: the counted value did not move in the direction set (source {before}, result {after}).
issue.code_checksum: The profile code is incomplete or was changed (checksum does not match).
issue.code_malformed: This is not a valid profile code.
issue.code_unsupported_version: Profile codes of version {version} are not supported.
issue.custom_slider_invalid: Own slider “{id}” is invalid and was ignored.
issue.doc_too_long: The file is too long (limit {limit} characters).
issue.input_language_mismatch: The text seems to be in {found}, but the text language is set to {expected}. The model may then translate. Change the text language and run again.
issue.input_too_long: The text is too long (about {tokens} tokens, limit {limit}).
issue.input_too_short: The text is too short (at least about {minimum} tokens).
issue.internal_error: An unexpected error occurred. Details are in the server log.
issue.invalid_slider_value: The value of slider “{id}” is invalid and was ignored.
issue.llm_auth: The language model rejected the access key.
issue.llm_bad_request: The language model rejected the request (often: text too long for the model).
issue.llm_budget_exhausted: The model used up its output budget without producing text (often caused by reasoning).
issue.llm_deadline: Gave up after {attempts} attempt(s): the total waiting time was exhausted.
issue.llm_empty: The language model returned an empty answer.
issue.llm_failed: The request to the language model failed ({attempts} attempt(s)).
issue.llm_not_found: The configured model or endpoint does not exist.
issue.llm_status: The language model answered with status {status} ({attempts} attempt(s)).
issue.llm_timeout: The language model did not answer in time ({attempts} attempt(s)).
issue.llm_unreachable: The language model cannot be reached ({attempts} attempt(s)).
issue.metrics_too_short: The reference texts are too short for measured metrics (about {minimum} words needed).
issue.neutral_only: No target style is set, so the result is the neutral text.
issue.neutral_skipped: No neutralisation dimension is selected, so the text was styled directly.
issue.no_style: Nothing to do: choose a profile or activate at least one slider. To only neutralise, use “Neutralise, then style”.
issue.output_only_reasoning: The model returned only reasoning and no text. Try again, or configure the model to answer without reasoning.
issue.profile_field_type: The profile field “{field}” has the wrong type.
issue.profile_invalid_value: The invalid value in “{field}” was corrected.
issue.profile_language_mismatch: The profile was made for texts in {profile}; the text is in {text}. Its description may transfer only partly.
issue.profile_truncated: “{field}” was shortened to the limit of {limit}.
issue.profile_wrong_format: This is not a text-style profile.
issue.refine_no_pairs: Add at least one pair of differing texts first.
issue.skill_invalid: The skill could not be created: invalid {field}.
issue.skill_long: The skill's instructions are long (about {tokens} tokens; recommended below {limit}). Consider fewer rules or a shorter description.
issue.skill_no_style: There is nothing to export: choose a profile or activate at least one slider.
issue.slider_value_clamped: The value of slider “{id}” was set to {value}.
issue.target_conflict_complex_short: Complex or convoluted sentences are set, but the target sentence length is only {length} words.
issue.target_conflict_level_long: A low language level (A1/A2) is set, but the target sentence length is {length} words.
issue.target_conflict_simple_long: “Simple” is set, but the target sentence length is {length} words. Both go into the instructions; lower the target or “Simple”.
measure.familiar_rate: Familiar address or contractions per 100 words
measure.intro: **Counted** in source and result (approximate; short texts vary more):
measure.too_short: Source and result are too short to count features (about 40 words needed).
profile.edit_rules_info: One rule per line, at most 12.
profile.loaded: Profile loaded and selected as own profile.
profile.loaded_review: This profile contains free text (description, rules or own sliders) that goes into the instructions for the model. Please read it before use.
profile.own_created: Your current settings were taken over as your own profile.
profile.own_replaced: Your current settings were taken over as your own profile; the previous own profile was replaced.
profile.session_empty: There is no own profile yet. Create one under “Copy a style”, load a code or a file.
profile.skill_info: A skill carries the current settings as instructions for Claude. **claude.ai:** Settings > Features, upload the ZIP (requires code execution). **Claude Code:** unpack into `~/.claude/skills/` or a project's `.claude/skills/`. **Claude API:** upload it through the Skills API. Only use skills from sources you trust.
refine.intro: Collect pairs of an original text and your hand-edited version. The model derives style rules from the differences and adds them to your own profile.
refine.pair_invalid: Both texts are needed, and they must differ.
refine.rule_missing: There is no rule with this number.
sidebar.info: Profile, neutralisation, sliders and measured targets. These settings apply in every tab.
sidebar.title: ⚙️ Settings
status.done: Done: {steps} step(s), {seconds} s, {tokens} tokens, {words} words (target about {target}).
targets.info: Values the result should come close to. “Copy a style” presets them from the reference texts; you can change each one or switch it off. Only active targets are used; moving a slider activates it.
targets.title: 📏 Measured targets
transform.input_ph: Paste the text to be rewritten…
transform.neutral_info: Editable. Reused as long as text and neutralisation settings stay the same.
transform.settings_hint: Profile, sliders and targets are set in the side bar **⚙️ Settings**.
transform.sliders_info: Only sliders marked as active are used. Moving a slider activates it; untick “active” to switch it off. Choosing a profile sets the sliders; you can adjust them afterwards.
transform.upload: …or upload a file (txt, md, docx). It is deleted on the server right after reading.
wizard.name: Name of the style
wizard.next_steps: **Next:** step 2 shows the settings derived from the text.
wizard.step1_info: Enter one or more of your own texts. The analysis derives a profile from them; the texts themselves are not stored in the profile or the skill.
wizard.step2_info: The analysis has set the sliders and measured targets shown below. Adjust them in the side bar **⚙️ Settings**; areas with settings are open. Description and rules can be edited here.
wizard.step3_info: Rewrite a test text of at least 40 words with the current settings. The table compares source, target and result; the previous attempt is shown next to it. Adjust the settings in the side bar and repeat.
wizard.step4_info: Export the current settings as a skill. The profile code below is a copy of the settings for later adjustments.
wizard.test_ph: A text in another style, for example a factual notice
